result.summary: Vodafone Idea currently has one open overdue invoice of INR 9M, 19 days past due (vs. INR 120M credit line, so exposure coverage is not a concern). However, resolution lag has been lengthening across the last three notifications (5 days late → 9 days late → currently 19 days and still open), all from the same policy (TCI-SCF-2026-0001), indicating a worsening payment pattern rather than a one-off delay.
concerns: Days-to-resolve trend is increasing (5 → 9 → 19+ days), suggesting slowing payment discipline
Current overdue is still open at 19 DPD with no resolution date yet
All notifications originate from a single policy/insurer, limiting visibility into broader payment behavior
Slight uptick in notification frequency in the last 6-month window (2 vs 1 prior window) worth monitoring for further accumulation
